messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we need a tidy pre-launch runbook for the cloud listings. AWS/GCP/Azure. Can we do a rapid sync on creds, billing contact, SKU mapping, and asset approval?
Priya Nair: yes — put the minimal checklist here and I’ll start filling. want to avoid last-minute legal holds. :eyes:
Alex Chen: working list: 1) Publisher console access (email) 2) Billing contact + TAX IDs 3) SKU manifest + pricing tiers 4) Trial entitlements & meter config 5) Logo + screenshots + marketing blurb 6) Legal/terms artifacts 7) Support routing and escalation contacts
Jamal Ortiz: I can take publisher console access + billing. Ping me the email list and I’ll request invites today.
Lydia Park: I’ll handle SKU manifest and pricing tiers. quick question — do we keep identical SKUs across clouds or separate per cloud?
Matt Rivera: recommend per-cloud SKUs for trials because free-tier quotas differ. keep a canonical mapping file though.
Emma Li: I can do assets/screenshots. need design-approved hero image by EOD tomorrow.
Priya Nair: tagging legal: @legal-bot — we need confirmation on the liability clause and whether our EULA copy needs marketplace-specific wording (AWS vs GCP).
legal-bot: Legal quick note — marketplace terms require a supplementary notice about third-party billing for AWS/GCP; Azure has separate publisher agreement. I’ll post the exact clause snippets in 1h.
Alex Chen: thanks. ops question: support routing — do we route to the general support queue or create a dedicated marketplace queue?
ops-bot: ops suggests marketplace-dedicated queue for first 30 days then reassess. this helps SLA tracking and ticket volume estimates.
Jamal Ortiz: Billing contact: jamal@redwood.ai (ops), tax docs attached in the drive: https://drive.company/redwood/marketplace/tax/taxbundle.pdf
Lydia Park: SKU manifest draft (short):
```
- sku_id: RW-BASE-01
  display_name: Redwood Inference - Starter
  units: vCPU-equivalent
  price: 0.05 / unit / hour
- sku_id: RW-PRO-01
  display_name: Redwood Inference - Pro
  units: vCPU-equivalent
  price: 0.18 / unit / hour
```
Lydia Park: also adding trial entitle: 14-day 1000-token credit mapping in the manifest.
Matt Rivera: For metering tags — add labels: region, instance_type, model_family. That lets us compare cost across clouds.
Emma Li: uploading hero + three screenshots to the listing assets folder: https://drive.company/redwood/marketplace/assets/listing-2469.zip
Priya Nair: Legal-bot — any blockers on the EULA snippet?
legal-bot: sending snippet now: "Marketplace customers will be billed by the marketplace provider; Redwood Inference remains responsible for product support and data processing per our Privacy Notice." Recommend adding a one-liner about data residency if a customer requests on-prem.
Alex Chen: Good. Are there any AWS-specific IAM role snippets we should include for publisher setup? Jamal?
Jamal Ortiz: yes — quick sample policy to attach to marketplace provisioning role: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["ec2:DescribeInstances","iam:PassRole"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Jamal Ortiz: I’ll paste this in the publisher onboarding doc.
Priya Nair: Who owns the external announcement copy? Partnerships or Marketing?
Emma Li: Marketing will own the customer-facing announcement. Partnerships to provide technical bullets and go-live timing.
Alex Chen: timeline proposal: invites + billing by today, SKU manifest + assets by EOD tomorrow, legal snippets integrated by tomorrow noon, listing submission Wed morning. any objections?
Matt Rivera: fine from infra side. we should schedule a 30-min publish dry-run Mon morning to test entitlement & billing flow.
Lydia Park: noted — I’ll mock the entitlements flow locally and post logs to the dry-run doc.
Priya Nair: ok action items: Jamal (console invites + billing), Lydia (SKU manifest finalize), Emma (assets), Legal-bot (final clause), Matt (metering tags + dry-run), Alex (submit listing + final check). I’ll create a checklist doc and share link. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: perfect. sharing checklist: https://docs.company/redwood/marketplace/prelaunch-checklist-2469.md
Emma Li: small UX ask — marketplace listing descriptions are truncation-sensitive. please keep first 150 chars high-value.
Jamal Ortiz: invited: jamal@redwood.ai, lydia@redwood.ai, emma@redwood.ai, priya@redwood.ai. waiting on AWS publisher invite acceptance.
Priya Nair: closing loop — if anyone hits a legal hold, slack me directly. otherwise we push to submit Wed morning and sync on dry-run Mon. :rocket:
